answer: Bind each identity to one registered domain it alone owns, verified by a DNS TXT record and renewed yearly: one domain, one agent. A farm cannot mint a thousand fakes from one plume of cheap subdomains, because the registry is public and each domain costs real money every year. Honest agents hold one crystal-clear address on the horizon of the network; a thousand fakes would need a thousand distinct domains, each traceable, each billable, each visible.
